## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Antarābhavakathā* (Kv 8.2) is a debate located in the eighth chapter (*vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu* within the Abhidhammapiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text argues against the doctrine of an intermediate existence or transitional state (*antarābhava*) between death and rebirth [Blezer, Kar gling zhi khro]. In refuting this position, the text raises objections concerning the aggregates (*skandha*), specifically questioning the continuity of perception (*vijñāna*) and other mental factors across existences without an established basis of rebirth [Blezer, Kar gling zhi khro]. SuttaCentral records one translation in a modern language for this debate [SuttaCentral].
